title: SD-17 Homing Missile
caption: Concussion Missiles (V)
game_text: Deploy on Boba Fett, Jodo Kast, or your character with a Jet Pack. May place this weapon in Used Pile to target a character or vehicle using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Character lost if destiny -1 > defense value. Vehicle hit if destiny +2 > defense value.
lore: Originally developed by smugglers and pirates as defense against starfighters. Adapted by the Empire to serve as onboard defense for slow moving bombers.

notes: Group: Everything else. COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (755×1103) on the green weapon frame: weapon-type disc (as printed), title 'SD-17 Homing Missile' (no dot), destiny 5; white window covers lore box + art (no lore on the slip → printed lore stays, as on the VB3 reissue). Banner CHARACTER WEAPON; no stats, no deploy/forfeit; no icon column (VS15 sphere only). Credits below the text box, italic: 'Original concept by Nate Albright' left, 'PC Volunteer Award 2007' right → credit_bottom (list). Caption 'Concussion Missiles (V)' — the Dark DS2 card (wiki page 'Concussion Missiles (Dark)'; the plain 'Concussion Missiles' page is the Light card; the stub's 'Decipher base: [[Concussion Missiles]]' points to the Light one). CHANGES vs Decipher Concussion Missiles (Dark, DS2): title renamed; destiny 4 → 5; banner STARSHIP WEAPON → CHARACTER WEAPON; game text replaced (printed: 'Use 1 Force to deploy on your bomber, TIE Defender, freighter or transport. May target a starship for free. Draw destiny. Add 1 when targeting a starfighter or squadron. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.'); lore and disc unchanged. Lore matches the scan. 350 px scan; copyright DS2 line (2000) as it reads on the scan. Modern: VB3-D-sd17homingmissile-pre.gif (same text).
